name: Executor-class Star Dreadnought
description: The Executor-class Star Dreadnought, also known as the Executor-class Super Star Destroyer, officially identified during production as the Super-class Star Destroyer, and simply as the Super Star Destroyer class, the Super Star Destroyer and Super Class, designed by Lira Wessex were some of the largest and most powerful Imperial starships ever created. Along with other classes of massive Imperial capital ships, they were also referred to as Super Star Destroyers, although they were technically classified as Star Dreadnoughts. The most distinguished Super Star Destroyer was the Executor, flagship of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Vader.
